newsitem.title: USA: CACI International awarded Justice contract.
newsitem.headline: CACI International awarded Justice contract.

text.p: CACI International Inc said Monday it has been awarded a five-year, $11.3 million contract by the Justice Department to provide case management and operations support to the agency's civil division.
CACI will assist division managers in meeting case-management responsibilities and provide support for its information system computer and computer facility.
The contract consists of one year, followed by four one-year options.
